high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a musical titled "Dheema," which is described as an Anirudh musical. The poster has a vibrant and colorful design with a predominantly yellow and pink color scheme. Text: The title "Dheema" is written in large, cursive pink letters. Below the title, it states "An Anirudh Musical." Additional text includes: "Our First Single Out Now" in bold pink letters. "Love Insurance Kompany" (a playful misspelling of "Company").
